kind: developer-only binding model and task-local C harness; not a production adapter

c_shared_contract.handles: opaque as_registry_v0 and as_session_v0 pointers created and destroyed only through the ABI
c_shared_contract.structs: initialize with the matching as_*_v0_init helper; struct_size, abi_major and abi_minor are validated
c_shared_contract.strings: (pointer,length) on input; NUL-terminated borrowed output strings are copied immediately and never freed
c_shared_contract.buffers: all PCM, result and caller-configuration storage belongs to the caller
c_shared_contract.calling_convention: Cdecl / C ABI; no C++ or managed types cross the boundary

cpp.ownership: one unique owner; destructor releases session before registry and cannot copy the owner
cpp.borrow: Span-like non-owning views over caller PCM; copy config bytes before create
cpp.status: documented model only; no shared C++ wrapper added

rust.ownership: Drop releases session before registry; process requires an exclusive borrow; no Send/Sync claim
rust.borrow: caller retains input/output slices and the effective-config buffer for the duration of each call
rust.status: DEFER: no rustc/cargo locally available; no registry download or native Rust build performed

csharp.ownership: SafeHandle-style ReleaseHandle calls as_session_close_v0, then the registry handle is released
csharp.borrow: Span<float> over caller memory; no library pointer is retained past the call
csharp.status: documented model only; no .NET SDK or build claim

caller_owned_inputs: as_error_v0 storage for every control call
char effective[4096] for canonical effective-configuration bytes
as_create_config_v0 whose config_json slice is borrowed for the create call
float input[160] and float output[160] in separate, naturally aligned buffers
as_frame_v0, as_output_v0 and as_result_v0 initialized before use

c_boundary.off_mode: guard executable only; no AudioSDK find_package, link, header include or registration
c_boundary.on_mode: links installed AudioSDK::audio_sdk for the task-local synthetic harness only
c_boundary.parity: harness_output.json is compared exactly against the Python contract model
